events.verdict: Holiday (BOS) establishes himself in Wiggins' (GSW) path and does not deliver contact as he releases away from the pick.
Queta (BOS) and Looney (GSW) both engage with each other on the perimeter and the contact quickly dissolves.

Horford (BOS) avoids making any illegal contact with Curry (GSW) during his driving shot attempt. Tatum (BOS) places a hand on Curry's body, but the contact is incidental to his effort to block the shot attempt.
Tatum (BOS) leans into Looney (GSW) but does not dislodge him from his defensive position.
Looney (GSW) steps backwards and onto Tatum's (BOS) foot, initiating contact that affects his jump shooting motion.
White (BOS) absorbs the contact that occurs with Looney (GSW) during the screen.
White (BOS) reaches in and initiates illegal contact to Green's (GSW) side in transition.
White (BOS) commits a take foul on Wiggins (GSW).
Curry (GSW) cleanly dislodges the ball from White (BOS) during his upward shooting motion.
Curry (GSW) initiates contact to Pritchard's (BOS) arm immediately after grazing the ball and the illegal contact affects Pritchard's jump shot attempt.
Green (GSW) signals for and is awarded a timeout within five seconds.
Pritchard (BOS) commits a take foul on Green (GSW).
Pritchard (BOS) extends his hands into Anderson's (GSW) back, causing him to lose his balance.
